scientific_purpose: Test an assay-compatible TDI potency gate versus flat and conditional class training; measured TDI pIC50 above 4+log10(2) is satisfied by every known positive, unlike a primary-screen cutoff. Primary regression auxiliary supervision supplies broad measured-screen targets. Fully nested five-bag decisions, two seeds and two splits. CYP2D6_is_TDI
selection_rule: Three prespecified matched 20-epoch Morgan neural arms, shared architecture and measurements. Conditional and gated arms use identical fits; thresholds are tuned on all known inner class labels. No unknown TDI labels imputed, no historical model scores or fixed positive count.
limitations: Necessary potency condition verified on observed outcomes, not a guarantee of transport to blind compounds. Primary auxiliary values excluded from all fitting boundaries for held-out molecules. D6 still has no class labels in weak primary region; the potency gate alone cannot remove that identifiability gap. Repeated seeds, conditional group intervals omit training and protocol-selection uncertainty.
